result.rationale: TramCité is a public Québec City tramway project, not a CDPQ PortCo. Québec is project owner; Québec City and the RTC are the intended asset owners. CDPQ Infra and wholly owned Infra CITÉ Inc. are State mandataries serving as project manager/procurement lead and prospective maintainer. Although the framework contemplates future CDPQ Infra financing and return, realization requires Government approval and a future definitive agreement. No direct project equity, concession, definitive investment commitment, financial close or private ownership transfer had closed.

identityResolution.entityType: Public urban-tramway project, not an operating company
identityResolution.legalProjectEntity: Infra CITÉ Inc., a wholly owned CDPQ Infra delivery subsidiary and State mandatary; it is not the TramCité asset owner.
identityResolution.predecessorSuccessor: Continuation/rebranding of the Québec City tramway within Plan CITÉ; no corporate predecessor/successor transaction.
identityResolution.canonicalKeyAssessment: tramcite|canada identifies the project but not a CDPQ-owned PortCo.

ownershipResolution.requestedManagerFinding: CDPQ Infra owns 100% of Infra CITÉ Inc.; no disclosed CDPQ equity or title in TramCité assets.
ownershipResolution.assetOwners: City of Québec for non-transport assets; RTC for transport assets.
ownershipResolution.cdpqRole: Maître d’œuvre, procurement authority under mandate and prospective long-term infrastructure maintainer.
ownershipResolution.capitalStructure: Not finalized. Government contributions and conditional CDPQ Infra capital/deferred financing are contemplated; amount, return, repayment and funding sequence await the definitive agreement.
ownershipResolution.riskAllocation: Government controls objectives, budget, schedule, financing structure and approval. Target-price incentives, financing risk and operating terms remain to be finalized.
closingConditions: Government approval of final solution, price, schedule, roles and financing

operatingResolution.route: About 19 km, Le Gendre to Charlesbourg via Sainte-Foy, Université Laval, Parliament Hill and Saint-Roch
operatingResolution.stage: Planning and 14-month co-development; preparatory works underway
operatingResolution.operator: Réseau de transport de la Capitale (RTC)
operatingResolution.maintenance: CDPQ Infra, subject to final agreements

acquisitionExitCheck.result: No acquisition, equity subscription, concession, definitive investment agreement, financial close, sale, transfer, recapitalization, exit or cancellation involving CDPQ ownership was found.
acquisitionExitCheck.latestRelevantEvent: The 2026-07-16 AtkinsRéalis-Siemens systems co-development contract is a supplier contract; final pricing and parameters still precede full execution.

milestones.event: Québec and CDPQ Infra signed the implementation framework; Québec is project owner and CDPQ Infra maître d’œuvre.
Interface agreement identified Infra CITÉ Inc. as a wholly owned CDPQ Infra State mandatary and allocated asset ownership to the City/RTC.
Preferred civil and systems consortia entered a 14-month co-development phase.
Systems co-development contract signed; full execution still awaited final design, schedule and price.
